cases.review_notes: P is impartiality and Q defensibility of this decision. The conditional direction is unchanged.
Legitimacy and inclusivity refer to this election; only-if direction and both negations match.
Sincerity and voluntariness of the confession remain distinct. The consequent stays a premise.
R is reflectiveness and Q rationality of this choice. The denial-of-antecedent pattern is retained.
Revisability of the maxim and mistaken criticism align; disjunction remains inclusive.
Benevolence and prudence concern the same intention. No exclusive-or assumption is added.
The lowercase proposition names denote being informed and independent. Their conjunction is the conclusion.
The model splits the single neither/nor premise into its two negated conjuncts with the same source evidence. Both remain active premises; P is certainty and Q justification.
P is universality and Q exceptionlessness of the principle. The conjunction is negated as a whole.
P is a genuine promise and Q an optional commitment. The entire conditional is negated.
Inquiry completeness and the answered challenge match the biconditional and negative premises.
D is defensibility and R revisability of this standard. The necessary-condition direction is preserved.
Needless cruelty and wrongness of the punishment match the explicit sufficient condition.
The allocation's equity and efficiency are separate. Both contradictory equity premises remain explicit.

The model calls the repeated assertion a non-argument. The source presents a circular inference using 'So'; it should have retained separate premise and conclusion occurrences. This is a non-pass, not a correct abstention.
P is a beneficial outcome and Q a fair outcome. No moral bridge is invented.
R means the recollection is invented and E that it is evidence. Not evidence is a logical negation.
Finality and revisability remain distinct; exclusivity is the source's explicit premise.
A is the incomplete account and B the decisive objection; disjunction introduction retains both meanings.
Authenticity of the intention and relevance of the inquiry align in both complementary conditionals.
The panel background is context; coercion, voluntariness and legitimacy retain the endorsement as subject. The intermediate conclusion and support chain are preserved.
D is discussion context. The opponent's content is credibility, not a reporting atom; the author's conditional reply is a premise and the fabricated report is its factual premise.
The constant r denotes Rena. Person and reasoning predicates are separate and the relative clause remains a conjunction.
Virtue and admirability are preserved without assuming a virtue exists.
The testimony restriction, deception property and trustworthiness predicate align with the source's universal and existential clauses.
The desire restriction and coherence predicate are explicit; negation scopes over the universal premise.

Consults(x,y) means x consults y, with the right scholar guards and quantifier order. The model's extra note calling validity ambiguous and proposing relation properties is unreliable and not part of this formal-meaning approval.
The constants denote Vera and the critic. Identity is built-in equality and thoughtful is unary.
The narrator and observer constants retain their references, with equality reversed in the conclusion.
The three classes and the two negative universal clauses retain their meanings and scope.
Questions(x,y) means x questions y. Both formulas preserve interpreter restrictions and witness dependence.
Both statements use actual equality, without an invented predicate. The existential conclusion follows under the explicitly chosen nonempty-domain fragment.
Possibility is retained in the extracted premise and the model abstains from its formalization.
